question: Fill the blank so this caches the same thing as useCallback(fn, [a]):
say: Fill the blank so this use memo caches the same thing as use callback of fn with a.
explanation: useCallback(fn, deps) equals useMemo(() => fn, deps): useMemo caches what the function returns, here fn itself.
explainSay: An arrow that returns fn. Use memo caches the return value, which is fn.
